name: zc_water

tests.name: the water a pond is wearing is translucent, not opaque

detail.note: the old master was BLEND_OPAQUE, so no parameter value it had could ever look wet

tests.name: the ponds, wells, canals and basins are actually wearing it

detail.note: counted by the material each surface wears in the live world, not by the log line

tests.name: the capture was still rendering while the world was paused

detail.note: exposure moved one and a half stops with the game paused; a frozen capture would report 0.0 here, and then the paused control under Q02 would prove nothing

tests.name: the measurement actually looked at something

detail.note: both flat means the render target came back empty, and Q02 would then be decided by blank pictures rather than by the water

tests.name: the water moves, and stops moving when the world is paused

detail.note: same view and same renderer noise on both sides; pause removes only the animation, so the gap between them is the flow and nothing else
